themes.title: Angelology and Spiritual Warfare
themes.description: The nature, hierarchy, and roles of angels and demons, including the divine council, the fall of angels, and the ongoing spiritual battle between God's forces and fallen angels. This theme also covers the practical aspects of spiritual warfare, such as discernment and the armor of God.

themes.title: Christology and Incarnation
themes.description: The identity and work of Jesus Christ, including His pre-incarnate appearances in the Old Testament, His incarnation as Plan A, His role in the divine council, and His victory over demons and death. This theme also covers the relationship between theophany and incarnation.

themes.title: Theosis and Deification
themes.description: The Orthodox Christian understanding of salvation as theosis, the process of becoming partakers of the divine nature and becoming like God. This theme contrasts with Western views focused on justice and explores related concepts such as sanctification, adoption as sons, and the promise to Abraham.

themes.title: Divine Council and Monolatry
themes.description: The biblical concept of the divine council, the assembly of angelic beings over which God presides, and the understanding of God as the Most High who governs through these beings. This theme also explores the concept of monolatry as opposed to modern monotheism, and the identification of pagan gods as fallen angels.

themes.title: Sacrifice and Atonement
themes.description: The biblical understanding of sacrifice as a means of communion and reconciliation with God, rather than substitutionary punishment. This theme covers the Old Testament sacrificial system, the priesthood of Melchizedek, and the atonement of Christ as a cosmic victory.

themes.title: Resurrection and Afterlife
themes.description: The Christian doctrine of bodily resurrection, the nature of the soul, the intermediate state, and the final judgment. This theme also covers the Harrowing of Hades and the hope of eternal life.

themes.title: Church and Sacraments
themes.description: The role of the Church as the body of Christ, the sacraments as means of grace and participation in Christ, and the liturgical life as participation in the divine council. This theme also covers baptism, the Eucharist, and the veneration of saints.

themes.title: Scripture and Hermeneutics
themes.description: The proper interpretation of Scripture, including the use of typology, the role of the Church Fathers, and the continuity of the Old and New Testaments. This theme also addresses the authority of Scripture within Tradition and the dangers of anachronistic readings.

themes.title: Paganism and Idolatry
themes.description: The biblical portrayal of pagan gods as demons and the dangers of idolatry. This theme also explores the relationship between Christianity and pagan religions, debunking claims of borrowing and highlighting the distinctiveness of Christian faith.

themes.title: Old Testament History and Narrative
themes.description: The historical and theological framework of the Old Testament, including the patriarchs, the Exodus, the monarchy, the exile, and the restoration. This theme also covers the promises to Abraham and their fulfillment in Christ and the Church.

themes.title: Torah and Law
themes.description: The nature of the Torah as Israel's way of life, its role in both Old and New Testaments, and its relevance for Christian ethics and worship. This theme also covers clean/unclean distinctions, the death penalty, and the idea that Jesus fulfills the Torah rather than abolishing it.

themes.title: Demons and Deliverance
themes.description: The nature and activity of demons, including their origin, modes of influence, and possession. This theme also covers exorcism, spiritual warfare, and the power of Christ and his saints over demonic forces.

themes.title: Kingship and Priesthood
themes.description: The biblical concepts of kingship and priesthood, including the Davidic king as an icon of God, the office of the queen mother, and the royal priesthood of believers. This theme also covers the priesthood of Christ and the order of Melchizedek.

themes.title: Eschatology and Judgment
themes.description: The final judgment, the resurrection, and the consummation of God's kingdom, including the two-stage eschatology and the second judgment. This theme also covers the defeat of death and the devil, and the ultimate restoration of all things.

themes.title: Spiritual Beings and Humanity
themes.description: The interaction between angels, demons, and humans, including the influence of spiritual beings on human affairs, the concept of territorial spirits, and the noetic world. This theme also covers the role of saints and the communion of saints.

themes.title: Creation and Cosmic Order
themes.description: The biblical view of creation as ordered by God, the role of heavenly beings in the cosmos, and the re-enchantment of nature. This theme also covers the battle against chaos and the significance of sacred space.

themes.title: Mystery Cults and Gnosticism
themes.description: The relationship between ancient mystery cults and Christianity, and the heresy of Gnosticism. This theme debunks claims of direct borrowing and highlights the distinctiveness of Christian faith, while also examining the influence of Gnostic ideas on early Christian texts.

themes.title: Time and Eternity
themes.description: The nature of time from an Orthodox perspective, including God's relationship to time, human experience of time, and the liturgical calendar as a means of theosis. This theme critiques modern views of time and emphasizes the present moment as the locus of action.

themes.title: Modern Society and Culture
themes.description: The critique of modern and postmodern thought from an Orthodox perspective, including individualism, egalitarianism, and theories of progress. This theme also addresses the challenges of modern society, such as alienation and the need for community.

themes.title: Pastoral Care and Catechesis
themes.description: The practical challenges of pastoral care, the importance of catechesis for converts, and the building of authentic community within the parish. This theme also covers the role of lay ministry and the need for discernment in online Orthodoxy.

themes.title: Second Temple Judaism
themes.description: The historical context and theological developments of Second Temple Judaism, including the sects, the Apocrypha, and the messianic expectations. This theme also covers the influence of these texts on early Christianity.

themes.title: Heresy and Orthodoxy
themes.description: The distinction between orthodox Christian faith and various heresies, including Arianism, Gnosticism, and Calvinism. This theme defends the historic faith against distortions and emphasizes the unity of the Old and New Testaments.

themes.title: Spiritual Life and Asceticism
themes.description: The practices of prayer, fasting, and almsgiving as means of spiritual growth and union with God. This theme emphasizes the need for repentance, humility, and the struggle against passions.

themes.title: Identity and Community
themes.description: The nature of Christian identity as communal rather than individualistic, and the Church as the body of Christ. This theme also addresses the collective spirits of families and nations, the priesthood of all believers, and the Church as an alternative society.

themes.title: Theotokos and Saints
themes.description: The role of the Virgin Mary and the saints in salvation, including their intercession and veneration. This theme also covers the office of the queen mother and the distinction between veneration and worship.
